headline: Inspection due: chilled water main, segment S3, 61 years old.
text: Supply pressure has fallen 6 psi below its normal over 4 days while supply–return flow imbalance rose to 3.1%, a typical leak signal. It is running 8.5% over its normal energy use. It serves 9 buildings, including Chemistry, Birge and Sterling research labs. If it fails: 18 temporary chillers, about $67K a day.
bullets: Driving signal: pressure ↓ 6 psi (41% of risk)
Plan B if it fails: 18 chillers · ~$67K/day (estimate)
